caption:
the score was never the hard part

#oura #whoop #recovery

slides.text:
The score is
the easy part

Your ring says you slept badly

You already knew that

Then nothing

No plan. No what-do-I-do-with-this.
Just a number and a whole day

This is what closing
the loop looks like

Same night. Same number.

Different instruction

slides.heading: A score is a fact. A plan is a decision.
slides.body: SOMA reads the same night your ring does, then says what today should be and why
